name: qfd_res_slot_ru
structural_change: pin plan and outline derived from the res_ser cluster floorplan: 216 x 142.56, word + strobes on N (exact, 7-track pitch), conveyor in / out interleaved on E, S and W pin-free

job.purpose: Slot tile of the qfd_sp_res_ser cluster (TP8 v4b slot 777.6 x 518.4), drawn from the cluster down (tools/qwen_vm_me/res_ser_cluster_fp.py). Same RTL and benches as rh / rs. Outline 216 x 142.56 (util <= 58 %); exact pin plan: N = 552-bit word at a 7-track pitch above the macro, strobes / reset / strap at the E end, clk mid-face; E = conveyor, rd[k] / od[k] interleaved at 2 tracks; S and W pin-free. The closed rs view (259.2 x 172.8) cannot be composed (no channel, abutted stubs short); rt (216 x 129.6) failed the in-flow util line (62.6 %).
